premises.text: Cross-border payment platforms are territorial and costly for global digital entrepreneurs and creators
premises.evidence_span: Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Payoneer, all building cross-border payments that are territorial and not tailored to these needs

premises.text: Integrating multiple country payment APIs is complex, time-consuming, fee-heavy, and requires technical expertise
premises.evidence_span: the process of integrating with multiple payment APIs in different countries is incredibly complex. It is time consuming and leads to higher transaction fees. Even worse, these entrepreneurs and creators often need a high degree of technical expertise

premises.text: Unified no-code API ecosystem abstracts multi-provider payments so non-technical users get paid globally in minutes
premises.evidence_span: Mainstack provides a unified and robust API ecosystem that abstracts the complexity of integrating with multiple payment platforms, enabling non-technical entrepreneurs and creators to get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code

premises.text: Top-of-funnel no-code suites (websites, storefronts, invoicing, media kit) drive conversion beyond payments alone
premises.evidence_span: rather than enabling Sandra with just financial services like other guys would do, we enable them with no-code suites that make it easier for them to showcase their work and receive payments via websites, storefronts, invoicing, Media Kit, and more

premises.text: Real-time IP/geolocation detection routes each transaction to the right payment API
premises.evidence_span: sophisticated IP detection system that dynamically, in real time, analyzes Sandra's client's geolocation with other transaction parameters and use this data set to sort of inform which of the payments APS to call at what point in time

domains.name: No-code global payments and showcase suite

value.text: Anyone anywhere can showcase work and receive international payments simply and securely
value.evidence_span: enabling anyone from anywhere to showcase their work and receive payment from their customers in a simple and highly secure manner starting in minutes

causal_links.evidence_span: this alone creates a significant barrier to entry to over 195 million digital entrepreneurs globally
get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code

notes: Website/storefront/invoicing/media-kit list folded as facets of one no-code suite (P4). Customer count and GMV excluded as traction. Compliance/account approval treated as operational detail of the unified API path, not a separate premise.
